summary: Matches a menu slot selection id a2 against stored slot entries and dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch with the matching camera mode index (0-3 and 5-8 for the eight fixed slots, 4 for a variable-length array entry found by a stride-200 linear scan). Records the matched variable array index in this[15] and, when a3 is set, invokes a virtual update callback from vtable+16. Returns 1 after any successful dispatch, 0 otherwise.

operations.description: Returns 0 immediately when a2 (the slot id) is zero.
Slot 0: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[4], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 0, 1, 1).
Slot 1: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[5], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 1, 1, 1).
Slot 2: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[6], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 2, 1, 1).
Slot 3: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[7], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 3, 1, 1).
Slot 5: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[9], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 5, 1, 1).
Slot 6: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[10], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 6, 1, 1).
Slot 7: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[11], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 7, 1, 1).
Slot 8: when a2 equals the dword stored at this[12], dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 8, 1, 1).
Variable-slot branch: the entry count v5 is read from this[14]; when it is not positive the function returns 0 without dispatching.

Scans the variable-length slot array starting at this[8] in 200-byte strides until the stored slot id equals a2 or the scan count passes this[14]; on a match it dispatches ViewCameraModeDispatch(this, 4, 1, 1) and records the matched index in this[15].
When a3 is non-zero, invokes the virtual update callback stored at vtable+16 (the vtable read through this[0]) on this, then the function returns 1.
Returns 1 after any successful dispatch; returns 0 for a zero slot id, an empty variable array, or a variable scan that exhausts the entry count without a match.

clean_pseudocode: for (i = this[8]; i != a2; i += 200) { if (++index >= this[14]) return 0; }
unresolved: Sub-object field at +0x10 (vtable variable-check context per the existing analysis) is not directly dereferenced by this function; its role is unconfirmed.
The meaning of the camera mode indices 0-8 and of the trailing (1, 1) dispatch arguments is caller-side semantics not resolved here.
